researchReflections.2026-03-27: My research right now focuses on emotions, specifically how emotions are constructed in the brain. Going against the classic model of emotions where they are things that occur to us, constructionism posits that our brains are actually constructing emotions based on context, past events, and physiological signals. For instance you might have the same exact feeling in your stomach and body before you get on a rollercoaster as you have before you step up for a huge presentation. One of these experiences gets constructed as excitement and the other as anxiety.

cnNotes.title: Emotion-specific verbal fluency relates to the intensity and variety of emotional experiences but not their specificity
cnNotes.speaker: Wormwood et al.
cnNotes.body:
**One-line summary:**
- Emotion fluency was not associated with emotion granularity, but was associated with greater negative affective intensity and variety.

**What I'd challenge:**
- The validity of the emotion fluency task, with an only 0.52 test-retest reliability

**What I'd steal for my own work:**
- Participants choose which 5 days they would like to receive the survey, with the caveat of one day having to be weekend.

cnNotes.title: Loneliness Symposium
cnNotes.speaker: Anita Restrepo, Matthew Southward, Karen Smith, Elizabeth Holly
cnNotes.body:
loneliness symposium
- Anita restrepo 
    - Loneliness -> reaffiliation
    - Motivational
    - Prosocial behavior 
        - No immediate benefit to actor
        - Gain vs loss 
        - Loneliness leads to less prosociality in the past
            - Self report measures
        - Behavioral measure of prosociality
            - Lonelier participants more likely to work for others in both loss and gain
- Matthew Southward
    - Emotion regulation and loneliness
    - Unified protocol - cbt 
        - Can these help reduce loneliness in clinical samples
        - Variety of skills predicted session to session reductions in loneliness
            - Not how often, how various
        - for BPD, frequency mattered more than variety of skills in reducing session to session loneliness
- Karen Smith
    - Loneliness in early childhood heightens negativity judgements
        - Loneliness not a negative thing itself - motivation for social contact
        - Prioritization of avoidance leading to perpetual loneliness
        - Who leverages loneliness effectively vs not
        - Loneliness emerges as young as 4-5 years old
        - When in early childhood does this exert effects
        - Facial sorting into two rooms valence good or bad
        - Loneliness shifts interpretations of affective information
            - Heighten avoidance and withdrawal
- Elizabeth Holly
    - Adolescent social isolation in mice
        - Associated with increased risks like anxiety, reward behaviors, cardiovascular
